source: Resolved chassis/docs tokens of the web-px, web-vw and web-scss presets, and of web-px with outputReferences (web-px-references), from the SD 5.5 build, with the matching baseline lines of build/tokens/test/golden/, extracted 2026-09-27. "tokens" holds, per preset, every token under test and every token it looks up, keyed by path. "variables" holds the variable names that the web-px-references cases look up, by path.
